ownership.quote: Founded in 2024 by Felix Martin Eckert and Adrian Ziegler, CloudCruise has 7 employees based in San Francisco.

stage.quote: Today, we're announcing our $5M seed round, backed by Floating Point, Meridian Street Capital, Twine, Refract Ventures and angels like Zack Lipton (CTO, Abridge) and David Singleton (fmr. CTO, Stripe).
